verdict.rationale: Mastra ships an MCP docs server and embedded package docs so AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) can read its APIs and help scaffold agents via natural-language prompts, and 'create your first agent with a single command' suggests some NL-driven scaffolding, but there is no dedicated first-party CLI/chat interface documented for operating the framework itself purely via natural-language commands. Missing for 10: a dedicated NL command interface or chat-driven control plane for the framework, independent hands-on evidence of NL-driven operation succeeding.
